arguments.name: version_needed
arguments.text: An optional version specification. If supplied, ensures that RStudio is at least that version.

arguments.name: child_ok
arguments.text: Boolean; check if the current R process is a child process of the main RStudio session? This can be useful for RStudio jobs, where the child communicates back with the main R session.

origin.details: Outside RStudio the GUI is not RStudio, so the result is false and version_needed is not evaluated. child_ok reaches the parent only when this process is an RStudio job.
origin.value: A boolean. FALSE when RStudio is not running.

translation.example:
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from rstudioapi.is_available import isAvailable
value = isAvailable()
if value is True:
    text = "TRUE"
elif value is False:
    text = "FALSE"
else:
    text = repr(value)
print("[1] " + text)
